entries.label: P: “Konstantin Đuričković is a Product Owner and Co-Founder at …”
entries.value: Konstantin Đuričković is a Product Owner and Co-Founder at OOX Limited, focused on product validation, rapid prototyping, and disciplined execution in mobile game development.

entries.label: P: “Pragmatic by instinct and disciplined by choice, he doesn’t…”
entries.value: Pragmatic by instinct and disciplined by choice, he doesn’t romanticize product ideas — he tests them. For him, ideas earn the right to exist through measurable results, not enthusiasm. He builds steadily, removes what doesn’t serve the goal, and prioritizes long-term trust over short-term wins.
